purpose: Provide a controlled accounting, tax, corporate-reporting, and evidence framework without replacing the company accountant, auditor, counsel, or regulator.
human_note: This module governs records and review gates. It does not calculate tax from incomplete facts or certify compliance.
authoritative_sources: Current BIR Form 2303 and BIR notices
Filed tax returns and payment confirmations
Registered books of accounts or approved accounting system records
SEC certificate, Articles, Bylaws, GIS, AFS and filed amendments
Current local permits and employer-agency certificates
Bank statements and executed bank mandates

registered_tax_forms.0619E: monthly remittance form for expanded withholding tax
registered_tax_forms.1601EQ: quarterly remittance return for expanded withholding tax
registered_tax_forms.1604E: annual information return for expanded withholding tax

books_and_ledgers: inventory or materials register when applicable
share and stock-transfer records maintained under corporate governance
chart_of_accounts_minimum_groups: cost of sales or direct project costs
transaction_controls: Every entry requires date, counterparty, description, amount, account coding, project/client code, source document, preparer, reviewer, and approval evidence.
Separate quotations, contracts, purchase orders, invoices, collections, supplier bills, disbursements, withholding certificates, and bank evidence.
Do not net client revenue against supplier cost. Record gross transactions according to the applicable accounting framework and accountant-approved policy.
Use accrual recognition and invoice terminology consistently with the EOPT framework, subject to the accountant’s treatment of each transaction.
Reconcile invoice numbering, sales ledger, collections, bank deposits, percentage-tax base, and income-tax revenue every close.

monthly: management approval and locked close package
quarterly: archive filed returns, acknowledgments, and payment evidence
annual: prepare financial statements under the applicable Philippine reporting framework
prepare SEC GIS and AFS filing package
renew local permits and verify employer-agency records

filing_rules: Build deadlines from the current COR, current BIR/SEC rules, and actual meeting/fiscal dates. Do not hardcode a perpetual compliance calendar in the kernel.
File required returns even when there is no operation or no tax due if the registration and current rules require filing.
Preserve electronic filing acknowledgments, payment confirmations, submitted return copies, and reviewer sign-off.
Escalate late, amended, disputed, or mismatched filings to the accountant and counsel as appropriate.

segregation_of_duties.reviewer: checks coding, tax treatment, arithmetic, and completeness
segregation_of_duties.approver: authorizes filing/payment or release under corporate authority
segregation_of_duties.custodian: locks records, versions, retention evidence, and access history

automation_rules: AI may classify, draft, reconcile, flag anomalies, and assemble workpapers but may not invent transactions, alter source evidence, approve entries, file returns, or authorize payments without human review.
Every AI-assisted accounting output must retain source links, confidence or exception flags, preparer identity, reviewer identity, version, timestamp, and immutable audit history.
Never expose internal margins, supplier costs, bank data, or unpublished financials to client-facing agents or templates.
open_verification_items: Inspect the current GSSC_CoR.pdf in full and capture exact tax-type start dates and current registered address.
Obtain and register the current Mayor’s/Business Permit and ancillary permit numbers, validity dates, and issuing offices.
Inspect underlying SSS, PhilHealth, and Pag-IBIG employer certificates; Pag-IBIG number is not established in the reviewed data.
Confirm registration and status of books of accounts or approved computerized accounting system.
Confirm the management-approved public mobile number because +63 928 370 3574 and +63 917 347 4007 both appear in current materials.
Reconcile current board/officer titles and signatory authorities against executed minutes, resolutions, SEC GIS, and bank mandates.
Correct all live profiles and templates that state an 8% option or show future-only officers as current.
hard_stops: no filing without source workpapers and human approval
no payment instruction from public/client documents
no deletion or overwrite of source evidence
no declaration of full compliance without current certificates and filing proofs
